description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0025 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Token price: current USD price of one token by contract address from DEX data, plus market cap, FDV, 24h volume, liquidity and 24h change. Base, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche. Data: GeckoTerminal public DEX API (prices, pools, OHLCV across 8 chains). Not financial advice. When to use: Use token-price for one token, token-prices for up to 30 at once, token-price-history for candles, token-pools for liquidity.
